title: Big Bold Creamy Vanilla Custard 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Big Bold Creamy Nic Salts Vanilla Custard is the ultimate treat for dessert lovers, delivering the rich, smooth taste of creamy vanilla custard in every puff. The luxurious vanilla flavour is perfectly blended with the indulgent notes of custard, creating a silky-smooth vape experience that’s both sweet and satisfying. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Big Bold Nic Salts are designed for use with mouth-to-lung (MTL) starter kits and pod devices. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these nic salts provide smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine relief, making them ideal for recent ex-smokers or vapers looking for a fast, satisfying alternative to traditional tobacco products. If you love this flavour, there are several other flavours to try from Big Bold’s collection, including Menthols, Creamy and Fruity flavours. Explore such beguiling blends as Honey Melon, Banana Milk, and Vanilla Custard for a Big Bold burst of flavour and a taste sensation like no other.
